[b]Gamsi operations in Lyuongo[/b]

The Gamsi, Daesun's foreign intelligence agency, was the final and most crucial layer of defense for the state. Tasked with operating in foreign entities and gathering intelligence on potential attacks on the state, its actions heed the nation's interests. An interest that took the form of a constantly shifting gaze, one that had forced the agency to soil its hands in the blood of the nation's victims.  

And soon, that nation turned its gaze southwards. Lyuongo was a ransacked nation embroiled in a rapidly escalating civil war, its northern half controlled by the far-left Lyuongo National Salvation army, ruled by infamous war criminal General Hein Wei. While the south, controlled by the waning Lyuongo federal government, a corrupt band of misfit puppets controlled by the many exploitative mining corporations, who rape the nation of its resources and exacerbate the already anguished lives of the common Lyuongan. Initially, Daesun had no interest in being involved in the war. Why send men to die in a country that they have no reason being in? This was the narrative until a discovery was made in which the nation proved to actually be wealthy in Uranium, a resource Daesun has longed for. The main pushback against involvement was the existence of Hayan-Dal, Daesun's closest ally in Kianzhou that provided the nation with already cheap Uranium. But there was a stark difference between Hayan-Dal and Lyuongo, Hayan-Dal was a state that had its own interests in the trade too, it knew what exploitation was. Tariffs, quotas, and many other barriers still existed in the trade of these goods, things that subconsciously undermined Daesun's advancement in nuclear technology. But Lyuongo was different, it was weak, vulnerable, and  most especially foolish. For there existed no such thing as "exploitation" in the fledgling's shut eyes, a fact Daesun relished. 

Gamsi operations in Lyuongo began as early as May, as the war kicked off interest in the flash-zone had increased exponentially. Their objective was simple, but required being precisely covert.  Two Gamsi agents, one male and one female, were to be dispatched to the opposing sides, with the purpose of pegging the nation a seat at the round-table in future negotiations. Separate offers were made to either opposing side, with great contrast to avoid the suspicion that Daesun was pitting both sides against each other. 

The first offer, one made to the Lyuongan government, was rather rational militarily, as the state only wished to ensure the protection of the Uranium-rich south the LNA had dominion over. In exchange for future resource guarantees, PECA membership, de facto mylor currency domination, censorship, and political power within the nation, Daesun would offer a plethora of services to the state. First, Daesun granted the LNA access to its network services, allowing the nation once engulfed in the fog of war to reconnect with the outside world once more. Furthermore, Daesun would direct funds into the paving of roads and tracking of rails through the use of work permits to ensure operations in the state were utmost covert. Lastly, the final and most pivotal offer made by the Gamsi was the weaponization of the LNA. The Gamsi worked tirelessly to secretly transport thousands of Type 58 rifles, an older firearm philosophy ditched by the Daesunite army dating back to the late 1950s. This was all a part of the Gamsi's plan, as it made it virtually impossible to relevate the connection between Daesun and the LNA through the study of its firearm usage without sounding delusional.  

While Daesun's cooperation with the LNA was understandable, as it held similar ideals to the nation politically, the Gamsi's risky decision to work with the LNSA as well stood out as outlandish. The LNSA were communists, a sworn archenemy of Daesun since the ascendancy and collapse of its totalitarian socialist regime between the '50s and '70s. But to Daesun, these traits didn't matter. What mattered was the attainment of resources ... and addressing an even greater rival who, just like Daesun, was [i]also[/i] involved in the ever-growing situation. Aokashima was an island nation adjacent to Daesun in the strait of Imugi, but was also an age-old rival that had been competing with Daesun since the dawn of civilization. From its early wars with the Ryuk dynasty of the 1800s to the formation of A.C.P. in the contemporary era, Aokashima has stood the test of time. Resisting the ascension of Daesun as Kianzhou's first-ever superpower and challenging its throne as the continent's true hegemon. Aokashima's constant tug at Daesun's grasp on power proved to be a significant threat,  potentially dismantling the continental order that Daesun had established during the days of Thawne. Once more, Aokashima had tugged again. While Operation Blooming Lotus in the perception of more "simple minded" nations was a gallant humanitarian effort, Daesun viewed it as a direct challenge to its authority in the region. By intervening, Aokashima had trespassed into Daesun's own backyard, in search of satisfying its own insatiable greed. This could not go unaccounted for, and Daesun had to act fast to ensure it could recuperate its strategic advantage in the Imugi strait. 

To ensure Daesun could advance its strategy in Lyuongo, and put Aokashima on the backfoot. The Gamsi would also work to form underhanded deals with General Hei. In exchange for pledges to not strike uranium extraction facilities, future admission into PECA, mylor reserve currency status, and staunch anti-ACPism Daesun would grant a myriad of both military and financial aid. These, of course, took the form of multiple mediums, as it was crucial  to keeping the operation completely secret. First, the transport of military firearms and other troop equipment were to be insured. In stark contrast to the main firearms Daesun donated to the LNA, the LNSA would instead be equipped with vastly alien but superior weaponry, such were the USO-built M1682s, CAR-15s, and M14. This was intended to give the LNSA a ground weaponry advantage, while also allowing for their inherent differences to cover up the nation's tracks in this affair. In addition, Daesun would also cycle satellite information on Aokashiman positions to local LNSA strike forces and air defenses, while also granting far-knit connection to Daesunite radar networks,  allowing for the LNSA to perform reconnaissance on the invading forces without the worry of expending its own resources. Anti-ship weaponry is  a crucial factor in  determining whether the LNSA would survive this trial, or totally and humiliatingly fail it. The overwhelming majority of Operation Blooming Lotus strikes took place in the form of naval salvoing, a tactic that had proved effective against LNSA but Daesun seeked to overturn this advantage. Through subterranean tunnel networks encapsulated in the cover of the Lyuongon jungle, Daesun would begin the donation of older but still effective P-15 anti-ship missile systems, while they were inherently  easy to intercept by modern naval electronics, they gave the LNSA the ability to fight back, and using them in large saturation attacks could prove effective in warding off the northern imperialists.

[b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2765593]Order of the New Erene[/url][/b]

In the name of Almighty God,

The Representatives of the Governments of the Vespurias, Montfleur, and Sallach have discussed at Kingsmount the situation in Elseyr, in particular the geopolitical events of the White Straits and the recent actions of the Elseyran Defense Union and the Socialist International. 

Impelled by these realities and further advised by those resolutions made at Andestaphe, and having also further considered the relevance of extant arrangements made in Valcoeur and Burrow, these Representatives have found themselves in common policy.

[list]1. They agreed that a common line of conduct, civilian and military in its character, must be pursued in defense of the White Straits and the International Alliance.

2. They examined the situation in Rosenmarkke and have affirmed prior designs by the Montfleurois Government to dispose of that state to its national institutions.

3. The information which they received from Charles de la Driennais, Comte de Porcéan regarding the conduct of Wuloosyan, Hochdeutsch, and Soviet forces in Rosenmarkke has affirmed prior suspicions of conspiracy to weaken and dismantle the capabilities of the White Sea powers to act against the designs of the EDU and the Socialist international.

4. The information which they received received from the Vespurian informant regarding the initial operations leading up to Rosenmarkket capitulation has affirmed the utmost necessity of national rearmament, in particular the continued development of the Sallacher Government's Oriflamme Proposal to better conduct the interests of these Governments in modern warfare.

5. In tackling the issue of militarization and rearmament, the Representatives of the three governments recalled the situation of the Rosenmarkket state when, in its preliminary moment of geopolitical arising from the decline of the Hydronic state and the increasing isolation of the Vespurian state from geopolitical affairs, that it was regretfully and unilaterally aggressed upon in direct contravention of preexisting public confidence in a peaceful and tranquil order. The sheer magnitude of the Rosenmarkket defeat has affirmed to the Representatives that all preexisting quantitative and qualitative assumptions about the necessity for peace in this time was now totally invalidated hitherto by the debased traditions of warmongering and conquest now expressed by the leading powers of Erene, in particular the Elseyran Defense Union, which until now continues to sustain itself through anxiety and terror. The Representatives therefore affirm their earnest desire to sustain the peace of Erene by establishing that 'Order', and to practice within it every possible effort to promote a world that is free of the same anxiety and terror.

6. As regards to the formation of that 'Order' for the Eastern Straits which had been initially proposed by the government of the Comte d'Ardalay, the Representatives agreed to a set of basic principles and the procedure therewith, the contents of which shall be elucidated below.[/list]

[spoiler=[b]Final Declaration of the Kingsmount Conference[/b]]

[b]Final Declaration of the Kingsmount Conference[/b]

[list][b]ARTICLE I[/b]. The state of Rosenmarkke is annexed to the Kingdom of Montfleur, to which it shall adhere by its constitutions and institutions, and by the rulership of His Majesty the King of Montfleur and his successors in perpetuity. The Rosenmarkket and the Thrømm shall obtain representation in the whole territory of Montfleur according to which is expedient by the constitutions and institutions therewith.

[list]1. This action in pursuance of Article II and III of the Treaty of Tharkønn signed last 11 August 2028.

2. The institutions of the former Rosenmarkket state shall remain in continuous contact with the High Contracting Parties until the cessation of all duties.[/list]

[b]ART. II[/b]. His Serene Highness the Prince of Sallach is perforce affirmed to be strictly sovereign and independent of the Kingdom of Montfleur, as is the Principality of Sallach, whom he is affirmed to rule with his successors in perpetuity.

[b]ART. III[/b]. The High Contracting Parties of this Kingsmount Conference solemnly affirm the necessity of diplomatic negotiations for the development of peace and tranquility in Elseyr and in all Erene.

[list]1. The High Contracting Parties mutually renounce war as an instrument of government policy against one another and to proclaim for this purpose perpetual peace and friendship as protectors of the Eastern Straits.

2. And also mutually guarantee the territorial integrity and existing constitutional forms of one another. Neither signatory shall entertain claims, whether historic or revived, upon the lands, titles, or institutions of another.[/list]

[b]ART. IV[/b]. If the common interests of the High Contracting Parties be threatened by geopolitical events of any kind whatsoever, that they must assist each other with full political and diplomatic support to eliminate this threat, or to come immediately to the assistance of their allies with all military forces on land, at sea, in air, and outer space.

[b]ART. V[/b]. That war, once engaged, shall only be concluded by an armistice and peace unanimously agreed by the High Contracting Parties.

[b]ART. VI[/b]. An Order shall be formed by these signatories in close adherence to the principles that have been stated therewith, to coordinate and collaborate on matters of economic and financial detail, on customs and currency, communication, culture, health and social welfare, and defense against foreign aggression.

[b]ART. VII[/b]. The Order shall also have a Council of Sovereigns composed of the delegates of each member State, assigned according to population and election, who shall organize into committees to advise the High Authority.

[list]1. The Council shall be led by a Chair of the Council of Sovereigns who organizes the ordinary and extraordinary sessions of that Council.

2. That this Chair shall be appointed upon a simple majority vote of the Council, and their junior offices appointed by the Chair with the approval of the Council.

3. Should a dispute arise between any two of the High Contracting Parties which cannot be resolved by direct negotiation, they shall refer the matter to the Chair of the Council of Sovereigns, who shall offer their good offices for conciliation before any other action is taken.[/list]

[b]ART. VIII[/b]. The Order shall also possess a High Authority constituted by a single representative from each member State, which shall empower and realize the purpose of the Order and to perform through its mandate the civil and military duties necessary to exercise the ideal of a peace and tranquil Erene.

[list]1. The High Authority shall be led by a High Representative and junior Representatives, as well as their assistants and secretaries, who are appointed through the Council.

2. All Representatives in the High Authority serve for six year terms each, which may be repeated in perpetuity provided just elections.

3. The High Authority shall exercise responsibilities over the budget of the Order, to be subject to the approval of the Council before each fiscal year.[/list]

[b]ART. IX[/b]. There shall be a Military Directorate between the High Contracting Parties to properly organize matters of force in the settlement of disputes.

[b]ART. X[/b]. The High Aurthority of the Order shall be at Andestaphe, while the Military Directorate shall be at Burrow. The Council of Sovereigns may meet at any other place it designates.

[b]ART. XI[/b]. Any sovereign state which accepts the principles of this Declaration may apply to accede to this Order. Admission shall require the unanimous consent of the Council of Sovereigns and the assent of the High Authority.

[b]ART. XII[/b]. The Order shall adopt a symbol, banner, and motto. The use of national flags and arms shall remain unaffected.

[list]1. The symbol of the Order shall be the Eye in Splendor.

2. The flag of the Order shall be Gules, the Eye in Splendor Or rayed Sanguine.

3. The motto of the Order shall be [i]Ad ipsum currit iustus, et exaltabitur[/i], or in Llyndorran "The righteous runs to it and is set on high".[/list]

[b]ART. XIII[/b]. This Declaration shall enter into force upon its publication in two official gazettes in general circulation.

[b]ART. XIV[/b]. The proceedings of the Council of Sovereigns and the High Authority shall be conducted in Llyndorran, but any delegate may address the body in their own tongue, with interpretation provided by the secretariat. The authentic texts of this Declaration are those in Llyndorran, Montfleurois, and Sallic.

[b]ART. XV[/b]. This Declaration shall be ratified by each of the High Contracting Parties according to their respective constitutional procedures. The instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Government of Vespurias, which shall notify the other signatories of each deposit.[/list]

Done at Kingsmount the 1st of December, in the year of our Lord 2028.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Annexes to the Final Declaration[/b]]

[b]Annex on Hostile Organizations[/b]

The Elseyran Defense Union and the Socialist International, having taken advantage of the misery of the Rosenmarkket state, now seek to proclaim for themselves the fate and destiny of entire nations on the basis of barbarous and military might. Therefore, it is of great importance to this Order to exclude those nations that transact with either alliance to uphold its common goal of peace and tranquility.

[b]Annex on Military Conclusions[/b]

The Oriflamme Proposal, which is now under operation in the Principality of Sallach, shall be eligible for integration into the military apparatuses of any such new states that successfully accede into the Order, but whose actual integration shall remain fully subject to the discretion of the Sallacher Government.

Furthermore, the High Contracting Parties have agreed that:

[list]

1. The current military capabilities of the newly unified Montfleurois state must be sufficiently rearmed at the earliest possible notice with supplies and equipment that shall adhere to a common standard set by all member states.

2. The Count of Porcéan's earlier statements on the presence of Socialist International forces in the former Rosenmarkke remain a topic of immediate concern, and any remaining vestiges therein must be aggressively and totally prosecuted until their total eradication.

3. There exists substantial opposition networks currently in operation against the Socialist International, namely the Qianxun monarchist movement and the Gythenan Commonwealth-in-exile, whose leading figures may be of great interest as observers or associates of the Order's military staffs.

[/list]

[b]Annex on the Economic Arrangements of the Order[/b]

Until such time that proper arrangements can be made by the Council and the High Authority on the exact economic arrangements of the Order, all transactions shall continue under the economic frameworks created by THEP. The preliminary arrangements presented by De Lorraine at Andestaphe concerning the creation of a common market shall thus far remain into force.[/spoiler]

The Elseyran Defense Union and the Socialist International, having taken advantage of the misery of the Rosenmarkket state, now seek to proclaim for themselves the fate and destiny of entire nations on the basis of barbarous and military might. Therefore, it is of great importance to this Order to exclude those nations that transact with either alliance to uphold its common goal of peace and tranquility.

[b]Annex on Military Conclusions[/b]

The Oriflamme Proposal, which is now under operation in the Principality of Sallach, shall be eligible for integration into the military apparatuses of any such new states that successfully accede into the Order, but whose actual integration shall remain fully subject to the discretion of the Sallacher Government.

Furthermore, the High Contracting Parties have agreed that:

[list]

1. The current military capabilities of the newly unified Montfleurois state must be sufficiently rearmed at the earliest possible notice with supplies and equipment that shall adhere to a common standard set by all member states.

2. The Count of Porcéan's earlier statements on the presence of Socialist International forces in the former Rosenmarkke remain a topic of immediate concern, and any remaining vestiges therein must be aggressively and totally prosecuted until their total eradication.

3. There exists substantial opposition networks currently in operation against the Socialist International, namely the Qianxun monarchist movement and the Gythenan Commonwealth-in-exile, whose leading figures may be of great interest as observers or associates of the Order's military staffs.

[/list]

[b]Annex on the Economic Arrangements of the Order[/b]

Until such time that proper arrangements can be made by the Council and the High Authority on the exact economic arrangements of the Order, all transactions shall continue under the economic frameworks created by THEP.
